About LoanIQ

Understanding the project, model and system.

Data-Driven Loan Approval & Risk Analysis

LoanIQ is a machine learning based loan approval prediction and risk analysis system designed to demonstrate how applicant, financial and credit information can be used to estimate loan approval probability.

LoanIQ
LoanIQ combines machine learning, data analysis and an interactive Flask web interface to provide loan eligibility predictions, applicant insights and model-based decision explanations.

🎯 Project Objective

The primary objective of LoanIQ is to build an interpretable machine learning system that estimates whether a loan application is likely to be approved.

The project also demonstrates how exploratory analysis, feature evaluation, classification models and model interpretation can be combined into a practical ML application.

📊 Dataset

LoanIQ uses a dataset containing 20,000 loan applications and multiple applicant, financial, credit and loan-related attributes.

The target variable is LoanApproved, representing whether an application was approved or not.

🚀 What LoanIQ Provides

🔮 Loan Prediction Estimates the probability that a loan application will be approved.
📈 Analytics Explores approval patterns across income, credit score, employment, education, loan purpose and other applicant characteristics.
🔎 Decision Explanation Shows the strongest model factors that contributed positively or negatively to an individual prediction.
🧠 Model Insights Provides model performance, evaluation metrics and information about the selected machine learning approach.

🧠 Machine Learning Approach

Several classification models were evaluated during model development, including Logistic Regression, Gradient Boosting and Random Forest.

Logistic Regression was selected as the final model because it provided strong predictive performance while remaining highly interpretable. This interpretability is particularly useful for LoanIQ because the system provides model-based explanations for individual predictions.

⚙️ LoanIQ Workflow

The system follows a complete machine learning workflow from data analysis to prediction and interpretation.

1
Data Loan application data is prepared and analysed.
2
Model Classification models are trained and evaluated.
3
Prediction New applicant information is passed to the trained model.
4
Explanation The prediction and influential factors are presented to the user.
